summary_en: 350,000 shares (3.18% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥460/share (settlement 2026-07-21). Upper limit ¥161.0M. Execution window 2026-07-21 morning only; order unfilled shares will be addressed through ongoing market purchases under a discretionary contract through 2027-03-24.
title_en: Notice of Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Market Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-17, GENDAI AGENCY's board approved the specific execution method for a portion of a treasury share acquisition program already authorized by the board on the same date. The company will conduct a single ToSTNeT-3 off-market purchase on the morning of 2026-07-21 at ¥460/share (the closing price on 2026-07-17). The block purchase targets up to 350,000 shares and ¥161.0M. The order is placed at a fixed time (08:45 JST) and unfilled shares will flow into the ongoing discretionary market purchase programme that runs through 2027-03-24. The broader authorization approved on 2026-07-17 covers up to 700,000 shares (6.36% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) and ¥350.0M total through 2027-03-24. Note: As of 2026-07-17, the company held 1.3M treasury shares out of 12.3M issued shares. The company disclosed separately (on the same date) its intention to cancel 940,000 treasury shares on 2026-07-24 and to dispose of 360,000 treasury shares as restricted stock units on 2026-06-26, such that treasury holdings will be reduced to zero by 2026-07-24.
